|kind=dmz-fusion
|sep=,
|title={{#if:{{{title|}}}|{{{title}}}|{{#invoke:Labels|name}}}}
|image={{#invoke:Labels|image|{{{image|}}}}}
|caption={{{caption|}}}
|sections=Summary, General, Result info

|Summary=Quote
|Summary_nolabel=yes
|Quote_nolabel=yes

|General=Method, Requirements, Duration, Item
|General_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|General}}
|Method_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Method}}
|Requirements_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Requirements}}
|Duration_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Duration}}
|Item_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Item}}

|Result info=Result, Ending
|Result info_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Result}}
|Result_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Result}}
|Ending_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Ending}}
}}[[Category:Fusions{{#translation:}}]]</includeonly><noinclude>{{Documentation}}</noinclude>
